subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Do the app owners endorse permanent question summaries and Skip as the stable native-client contract, with Control UI’s expanded question panel taking over the composer?
rationale: This is a cross-client user-experience contract rather than a narrow bug fix; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the lasting interaction model.

options.title: Approve the parity contract
options.body: Confirm persistent summaries, Skip, and web composer takeover as the intended product behavior, then require native after-fix evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep the recovery fixes but defer one or more visible behavior changes until platform owners define their preferred interaction model.

recommendation.title: Approve the parity contract
recommendation.body: Confirm persistent summaries, Skip, and web composer takeover as the intended product behavior, then require native after-fix evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned contributor assembled the cross-platform implementation and can coordinate the affected app surfaces.
